_about: Wave 354 P4 — Cover Letter USER_TO_FILL Auto-fill SCAFFOLDING (NOT a flat --config input).
_note: Structured defaults for the 17 USER_TO_FILL placeholders in tnnls_submission/cover_letter.md. Each entry reuses the Wave 351 P5 / Wave 352 P2 INTERACTIVE_DEFAULTS exemplar values from tools/render_cover_letter.py (already in the repo, NOT newly invented). Source paths point to FILL_GUIDE.md sections + the Wave 351 P5 / Wave 352 P2 audit docs that back the schema; no fabricated numbers. The user is expected to OVERRIDE every value with real names / institutional emails / affiliations before submitting. Hard guardrails respected: (i) NO-PUSH policy; (ii) ADDITIVE only — tnnls_submission/cover_letter.md is NOT modified; (iii) the 17 USER_TO_FILL placeholders in cover_letter.md remain UNCHANGED; (iv) defaults point to verified artifacts only.
_schema_compatibility: This SCAFFOLDING has the richer audit-trail structure required by Wave 354 P4 (version + auto_filled_count + per-placeholder {id, default_value, source_path, rationale}). tools/render_cover_letter.py --config expects a FLAT dict of the 17 field names; to derive the flat config: jq '{authors_block: .placeholders[0].default_value, editor_header: .placeholders[1].default_value, ..., corresponding_author_email: .placeholders[16].default_value}' tnnls_submission/cover_letter_FILL_AUTOFILL.json > /tmp/cover_letter_data.json. Alternatively, run the helper in --interactive mode (Wave 352 P2) which pre-fills prompts from /tmp/cover_letter_data.template.json — this scaffolding can be hand-flattened into that template.
